title: Travis CI API token: one-property twin (length)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the value's length differs from the contracted length. Legacy mutation notes: length: 21 characters vs the 22 both pinned tools corroborate and length: 23 characters vs the 22 both pinned tools corroborate. Twin of "Travis CI API token: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of travisci-api-token-dotenv: length: 21 characters vs the 22 both pinned tools corroborate. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
